en: The Couple consisting of Being Conjoined With, Produced By, and Following Upon Mind (Cittasaṁsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiduka); The Triplet of the Wholesome (Kusalattika).

Dependent on a wholesome state that is conjoined with, originated by, and concomitant with consciousness (*cittasaṃsaṭṭha-samuṭṭhāna-anuparivatti*), there arises a non-wholesome state that is not conjoined with, originated by, or concomitant with consciousness, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*)... Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is conjoined with, originated by, and concomitant with consciousness, there arises a non-unwholesome state that is not conjoined with, originated by, or concomitant with consciousness, by way of root-condition...
Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance. (For the indeterminate root, there are likewise only three.)
